candidate: Exploratory between-specimen bulk-transcriptome dispersion in native EMC versus fixed same-source fusion sarcomas; no new values inspected.

primary_prior_art.finding: Original study already computes sample-specific silhouette S-scores relative to own and other diagnosis groups; within-type low scores motivate outlier review. This is closely related existing clustering/cohesion prior art. Pure within-type dispersion is mathematically distinct from silhouette separation/cohesion and cannot be declared identical or automatically novel.
primary_prior_art.method: Uniform STAR/RSEM gene quantification; log-transformed TPM; top-quarter variable protein-coding genes; unsupervised tSNE/hierarchical clustering; source sequencing-year batch assessment.

allowed_selected_sections: Whole transcriptome sequencing and gene functional annotation
EWSR1 and TAF15-rearranged EMC feature a different gene expression pattern
primary_prior_art.finding: Twelve centrally reviewed NR4A3-FISH EMC tumors, seven EWSR1/five TAF15, have already published partner-associated transcriptional programs. Authors use >70% tumor nuclei and report similar matched FFPE/frozen tissue results. This does not prove no further quantitative comparison is useful, but already motivates partner-aware model sampling.

favorable_metadata_correction.inspection: Existing cached original S1 workbook header rows only; no row-level S-score, CINSARC, clinical outcome, expression, ploidy/purity or genomic observations inspected.
favorable_metadata_correction.meaning: Cleaned current metadata omits grade, fusion and purity fields, while the source table advertises them. Their actual donor-level completeness/suitability remains unexamined here, not absent in the primary source. Any future metadata extraction must restrict allowed covariates and avoid genomic mechanism/formation content.

scientific_value_challenge: Between-patient bulk-RNA dispersion alone does not measure within-patient spatial heterogeneity or tissue-to-culture fidelity. Known partner effects already motivate multiple models. A worthwhile new question must state the practical decision changed beyond this prior art, and separate source, mixture, grade, mean-expression and capture alternatives without threshold or gene selection after values.
exposure: Primary published qualitative transcriptome program conclusions and some published summary counts/statistics were read for prior-art assessment. Initial selected global-RNA/method paragraphs also displayed incidental non-EMC copy-number context. No structural mechanism analysis, denied task science body, genetic formation question, new RNA row values, dispersion endpoint or phenotype calculation was opened.
